I submitted an equal-weight portfolio of the 94 short-horizon time-series momentum signals, the 5-day and 21-day lookbacks across all 47 industries. It has a training Sharpe of 0.10 and a validation Sharpe of 0.41, which is low in absolute terms.

I chose it because it was the only family with a positive Sharpe in both periods. Portfolios built from the top training-Sharpe signals reached about 1.2 in training but came out negative in validation (about −0.2), so I dropped them as overfit. I did look at validation for the family-level comparison, so the 0.41 is not fully out-of-sample. The 5-day lookback alone scored 0.50 in validation, but I kept both lookbacks to avoid tuning to validation.
